interface.title: Auspice v3.1.0: Interactive Visualisation of Phylogenomic data (Nextstrain)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and interpreting results after the analysis pipeline (augur) has produced a dated tree with traits, and sharing that view
interface.what_it_is_for: Showing a pathogen's dated phylogeny next to a map of where samples came from, so a scientist can colour, filter, animate and zoom the tree to read how lineages diverged and spread between places.

data.note: Two bundled example datasets were served from the examples folder: minimal/v2 and minimal/v1, both titled 'Minimal (vN) auspice spec based on Zika pipeline' (31 Zika genomes, Nov 2013 – Nov 2016, 15 countries, 4 regions). Their only colourings are Country, Region and Date. Neither has mutations, genotype colouring or an entropy panel, and neither has any narratives.

features.name: Dated phylogeny viewer with layout, branch-length switch and clade zoom
features.general: Draw a tree of samples on a time or distance axis, switch between layouts, and zoom into a subtree by clicking its branch
features.specific: Phylogeny panel: RECTANGULAR / RADIAL / UNROOTED / CLOCK / SCATTER layouts, TIME / DIVERGENCE branch length, click a branch to zoom into the clade, ZOOM TO ROOT
steps: choose a layout
choose time or divergence as branch length
click a branch to zoom into that clade
press ZOOM TO ROOT to return
serves_tasks: View the tree on a time axis
Try other tree layouts
Compare genetic distance with time
Zoom into one lineage

features.name: Node inspector
features.general: Read the details of one sample or one inferred ancestor by hovering it, and open a fuller record by clicking a sample
features.specific: Tip tooltip (divergence, date, country), branch tooltip (descendants, inferred date, inferred country), click a tip for its info box (which also adds a sample filter chip)
steps: hover a tip for its tooltip
hover a branch for its descendants and inferred traits
click a tip to open its info box
remove the sample filter chip that the click adds
serves_tasks: Inspect one sample or one ancestral node

features.name: Root-to-tip regression (clock / scatter plot)
features.general: Plot each sample's distance from the root against its date, fit a line, and report the rate; optionally pick other axes
features.specific: CLOCK layout with 'Show branches' and 'Show regression' toggles and a rate estimate; SCATTER layout with x/y axis dropdowns and, once 'Show regression' is on, intercept, slope and R^2
steps: switch to CLOCK
read the regression line and rate estimate
toggle branches off to see only the points
switch to SCATTER and choose numeric x and y variables
switch on 'Show regression' (off by default in SCATTER) to read intercept, slope and R^2
serves_tasks: Estimate the rate of change from a root-to-tip regression
Plot tips against chosen axes

features.name: Colour-by with a shared legend
features.general: Colour every item by a chosen attribute, with one legend that applies to all linked views and highlights a category on hover
features.specific: Color By dropdown (Country / Region / Date) with legends on the tree and map; hovering a legend entry enlarges matching tips
steps: open Color By
choose a trait
read clusters in the tree and map
hover a legend entry to highlight its samples
serves_tasks: Colour samples by a categorical or continuous trait
Highlight one category from the legend

features.name: Faceted filter with summary chips
features.general: Narrow the dataset by searching attribute values or picking them from count lists, and show the active filters as chips that can be turned off or removed
features.specific: Filter Data search ('Region → South America', 'sample → …'), 'Filter by Country / Region' value lists with counts, header chips with eye (toggle) and trash (remove), 'Showing N of 31 genomes'
steps: type a value in Filter Data or expand a 'Filter by …' list
pick one or more values
read the 'Showing N of 31' summary and the chips
turn a filter off with the eye icon or remove it with the trash icon
press ZOOM TO SELECTED or toggle Focus on selected
serves_tasks: Restrict to one region by searching for a value
Filter by picking several values from a list
Zoom the view to just the filtered samples
Show only the selected samples' part of the tree

features.name: Date-range slider with animation
features.general: Limit the data to a time window with a two-handle slider, or play a moving window to watch events unfold, then pause and reset
features.specific: Date Range slider with date pickers, PLAY / PAUSE / RESET, and Animation Options (speed, loop, cumulative history); the window combines with other filters ('∩')
steps: drag a handle to set the window
see the tree grey out samples outside it
press PLAY to slide the window through time
press PAUSE to keep the current window
press RESET for the full range
serves_tasks: Narrow to a date window
Replay spread through time
features.check_note: The replay confirmed the slider, the '∩' combination and RESET, and ran out of actions before PLAY/PAUSE; the run's own screens 044–050 show PLAY moving the window and PAUSE holding it. Animation Options were never tried.

features.name: Linked transmissions map
features.general: A map of sample locations, sized by count and joined by inferred movement arcs, that follows the tree's selection and highlights matching tree items on hover
features.specific: Transmissions/Geography panel (Leaflet + OpenFreeMap): country circles or region pies, transmission arcs toggle, geographic resolution dropdown, re-fits to zoomed clade or filter, hover a circle to enlarge its tips in the tree, RESET ZOOM
steps: read circles and arcs for the current selection
switch geographic resolution between country and region
toggle transmission lines
hover a location to highlight its samples in the tree
zoom or filter the tree and watch the map follow
serves_tasks: See where samples are and the inferred links between places
Relate a place on the map to its samples in the tree
Aggregate locations at a coarser level
Show locations without the inferred links
Put the tree and map side by side

features.name: Explode tree by trait
features.general: Split one tree into separate subtrees wherever a chosen attribute changes, so each group can be read on its own
steps: open Explode Tree By
choose a trait
read the separate subtrees
serves_tasks: Split the tree into separate subtrees by a trait

features.name: Hierarchical dataset switcher
features.general: Choose a dataset through stepwise selectors, see the proposed change highlighted against the current one, and load it
features.specific: 'change dataset' dialog: minimal / v2 → v1, the proposed level shown in orange, LOAD PROPOSED DATASET
steps: click change dataset
change a level in the hierarchy
compare current and proposed
press LOAD PROPOSED DATASET

features.name: View-aware data export
features.general: Export what is currently shown, with zoom and filters applied, in several standard formats
features.specific: DOWNLOAD DATA dialog: Auspice JSON, timetree Newick or Nexus, metadata TSV, genetic diversity TSV, SVG screenshot
steps: set up the view
open DOWNLOAD DATA
read how many tips will be exported
click a format

Colour by genotype: only Country, Region and Date are offered
Narratives: the splash page lists none; needs a dataset that ships narratives
Frequencies panel: needs a dataset with tip frequencies, which the minimal examples lack
Measurements panel: needs a dataset with measurements, which the minimal examples lack
Second tree side by side (tanglegram): needs two trees for one dataset, which the minimal examples lack

Goal 'colour the tree by genotype': there is no genotype colouring because the example datasets carry no mutations.
